Remarks

Provides geometric, collision, and transformation operations for circles in 2D space.

ContainsPointSector(Vector2, Vector2, float)

Determines whether a point [p] is within a sector of the circle, defined by a direction vector [dir] and a sector angle [sectorAngleRad] (in radians). The sector is centered along dir and spans sectorAngleRad.

public bool ContainsPointSector(Vector2 p, Vector2 dir, float sectorAngleRad)

Parameters

p Vector2

The point to check.

dir Vector2

The direction vector representing the center of the sector.

sectorAngleRad float

The angle of the sector in radians.

Returns

bool

true if the point is within the sector; otherwise, false.

Remarks

sectorAngleRad defines the sector centered around the dir. If the angle between dir and the direction from the circle Center to p has a smaller absolute angle than sectorAngleRad, the function returns true, otherwise false.

ContainsPointSector(Vector2, float, float)

Determines whether a point [p] is within a sector of the circle, defined by a center angle [rotationRad] and a sector angle [sectorAngleRad] (in radians). The sector is centered at rotationRad and spans sectorAngleRad.

public bool ContainsPointSector(Vector2 p, float rotationRad, float sectorAngleRad)

Parameters

p Vector2

The point to check.

rotationRad float

The center angle of the sector in radians.

sectorAngleRad float

The angle of the sector in radians.

Returns

bool

true if the point is within the sector; otherwise, false.

Remarks

rotationRad is used to calculate the direction of the sector. sectorAngleRad defines the sector centered around the calculated direction. If the angle between the sector direction and the direction from the circle Center to p has a smaller absolute angle than sectorAngleRad, the function returns true, otherwise false.

Overlap(Collider)

Determines whether this circle overlaps with the specified collider.

public bool Overlap(Collider collider)

Parameters

collider Collider

The collider to test for overlap with this circle. The collider can represent various shapes such as circles, segments, rays, lines, triangles, rectangles, quads, polygons, or polylines.

Returns

bool

true if this circle overlaps with the specified collider; otherwise, false.

Remarks

The overlap test is performed based on the shape type of the collider. If the collider is not enabled, the function returns false immediately. The appropriate shape-specific overlap method is called depending on the collider's shape type.

OverlapShape(Segments)

Determines whether this circle overlaps with any of the provided segments.

public bool OverlapShape(Segments segments)

Parameters

segments Segments

A collection of segments to test for overlap with this circle. Each segment is defined by its start and end points.

Returns

bool

true if this circle overlaps with any of the segments; otherwise, false.

Remarks

The function iterates through each segment in the collection and checks for overlap with the circle using the OverlapCircleSegment method. The check returns true as soon as an overlap is found; otherwise, it returns false after all segments are checked.
